description: Registry of canonical WasmAgent protocol schemas — the single source of truth for every cross-repository contract. Downstream repos consume via @wasmagent/protocol (npm) and wasmagent-protocol (PyPI). Covers: AEP, compliance, AgentBOM, MCP Posture, Trust Passport.

schemas.title: AEPBase
schemas.summary: Common envelope every AEP evidence schema extends — schema_version, evidence_type, created_at_ms, trace_id, and produced_by_run_id (string, non-empty) reused by downstream evidence schemas.

schemas.title: AEPRecord
schemas.summary: Runtime action evidence and run provenance record — the core Agent Evidence Protocol contract.

schemas.title: EvidenceEnvelope
schemas.summary: Shared envelope base for all AEP evidence records — schema_version, trace_id, created_at_ms, and optional signature.

schemas.title: SeedEvidence
schemas.summary: Template seed schema establishing the AEP evidence JSON Schema baseline — pinned draft, $id convention, required, properties, additionalProperties:false.

schemas.title: CanonicalEvent
schemas.summary: Foundational normalized event record. Heterogeneous agent evidence is normalized into CanonicalEvents that an adapter maps onto an aep-record.

schemas.title: MemoryEvidence
schemas.summary: Tamper-evident memory read/write record — digest + prior_digest hash chain over a memory cell (keys: mem_ref, op, digest, prior_digest, timestamp_ms).

schemas.title: ConstraintIR
schemas.summary: Typed, repairable, prioritised constraint — superset of @wasmagent/core Criterion.

schemas.title: ConstraintViolation
schemas.summary: A failed constraint plus its location in the artifact.

schemas.title: RepairTrace
schemas.summary: Per-round repair record. Supersedes trace-pipeline's repair-trace-entry naming.

schemas.title: TaskSpec
schemas.summary: Public contract for a compliance run. One TaskSpec -> one run -> one ComplianceEvalRecord.

schemas.title: Rollout Wire Format
schemas.summary: Intermediate JSONL formats in the wasmagent -> evomerge data pipeline (branch/dpo/ppo records).

schemas.title: AgentBOM
schemas.summary: Agent Bill of Materials — machine-readable agent identity, capabilities, and trust metadata.

schemas.title: MCPPosture
schemas.summary: MCP Posture — tool surface, permission grants, and risk signals for MCP servers.

schemas.title: TrustPassport
schemas.summary: Trust Passport — signed, expiring, verifiable trust-state artifact for AI agents.

schemas.title: ReplayEvidence
schemas.summary: Deterministic-replay attestation — run_id, seed, input_digests, output_digest, engine_version.

schemas.title: CheckpointEvidence
schemas.summary: Signed checkpoint/fork record — checkpoint_id, parent_run_id, fork_of, state_digest, created_at_ms.

schemas.title: Checkpoint
schemas.summary: Snapshot of agent execution state at a point in time. Carries checkpoint_id, state_digest, created_at, and optional parent_run_id and fork_of for lineage.

schemas.title: Fork
schemas.summary: New execution lineage derived from an existing checkpoint. Records fork_id, source_checkpoint_id, fork_reason, and created_at for full provenance.

aep.title: Agent Evidence Provenance
aep.description: Runtime action and provenance evidence records emitted by WasmAgent agents. Every member extends the shared AEP base envelope (aep-base), which defines produced_by_run_id and the common timestamp/provenance fields.

compliance.title: Compliance Evaluation
compliance.description: Schemas for constraint-based compliance evaluation records, violations, evidence spans, and repair traces.

agentbom.title: Agent Bill of Materials
agentbom.description: AgentBOM schema for declarative agent component manifests used in posture and attestation workflows.

mcp-posture.title: MCP Posture
mcp-posture.description: Model Context Protocol posture schemas for verifying tool and server declarations.

trust-passport.title: Trust Passport
trust-passport.description: Signed portable trust attestation documents carried by agents across execution environments.
